data.name: Alih
data.gender_notes: Alih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alaa', meaning 'to be high, to rise, to help, to support'. In Islamic context, Ali is a name of Prophet Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph and cousin of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Alih carries the meaning “Exalted, High” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alih usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, high and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and courage, a leader and protector of the Islamic community.
data.etymology: Alih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, High.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alih total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عليہ
in_arabic.meaning: عليہ نام کا مطلب ہے شریفہ، بلند مرتبہ، عزت والی
in_arabic.long_meaning: عليہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'علی' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شریفہ، بلند مرتبہ، عزت والی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ حضرت علی رضی اللہ عنہُ النبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے داماد اور خلفاء راشدہ میں سے ایک تھے۔ نام 'عليہ' لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز انتخاب ہے، جو ان کی شرف، عزت اور بلند مرتبہ کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: علیہ
in_urdu.meaning: علیہ کا مطلب شریفہ، بلند مرتبہ، عزت والی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیہ ایک اردو نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'علی' سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب شریفہ، بلند مرتبہ، عزت والی ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ حضرت علی رضی اللہ عنہُ کا مقام و مرتبہ بہت بلند تھا۔ یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک خوبصورت انتخاب ہے، جو ان کی شرف، عزت اور بلند مرتبہ کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام روایتی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीह
in_hindi.meaning: अलीह का अर्थ है शरीफा, उच्च पद, सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीह एक हिंदी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है शरीफा, उच्च पद, सम्मानित। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के دامाद और खलीफा रशीद حضرت علی رضی اللہ عنہُ से जुड़ा है। यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण विकल्प है, जो उनकी शرف, सम्मान और उच्च पद की ओर संकेत करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_english.name: Alih
in_english.meaning: Alih means noble, exalted, and respected in Arabic origin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alih is derived from the Arabic root 'Ali', which means noble, exalted, and respected. This name holds significant importance in Islamic culture as it is associated with Hazrat Ali, the cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Alih symbolizes a person of high rank, dignity, and honor. The name is popular across various Muslim cultures and is chosen for its spiritual and cultural significance. It reflects qualities of nobility, respect, and elevated status.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ali has played a significant role in Islamic history and culture. Prophet Ali (pbuh) was an important political and military leader in the early Islamic community, playing crucial roles in both the Ridda Wars and the Battle of Khaybar. He was also a revered scholar and taught many aspects of Islamic law and jurisprudence. Additionally, Ali's name became associated with the Shia branch of Islam, who consider him as the rightful imam or leader after Muhammad (pbuh). Today, Ali is remembered as a symbol of courage, leadership, and purity within the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spiritual tradition, the name Ali is deeply connected to spiritual growth and enlightenment. Ali (pbuh) is considered a patron of those seeking knowledge and wisdom. He is also said to be a reliable intercessor before God, as evidenced by his famous title "At-Thiqatain" (The Two Trustworthy Ones) - referencing his labors for God as a spiritual guide and his role as the male imam for Aisha and Fatimah, the daughters of Muhammad (pbuh). Ali's devotion to God, unwavering morality, strength in adversity, and continuous love for the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) showcase his spiritual significance and serve as role models for Muslims. Therefore, both historically and spiritually, the name Ali has a profound impact and meaning within Islamic communities.
